    s.g = (1.0 - pow(oneMinusT.g, p1) - tPart.g);

}                                                               

vec4 rebalanceMoreMagenta (vec4 t, float p, float lambda)       
{                                                               
    vec4 s = t;                                                 
    vec4 oneMinusT = 1.0 - t;                                   
    float p1 = p + 1.0;                                         
    vec4 tPart = lambda*p*t*( 1.0 - t*t)/(p1*p1);               
    s.g = pow (t.g, p1)  + tPart.g;                             
    s.b = mix((1.0 - pow(oneMinusT.b, p1) - tPart.b), s.b, .5); 
    s.r = mix( (1.0 - pow(oneMinusT.r, p1) - tPart.r), s.r, .5);
    return s;                                                   
}                                                               

kernel vec4 moreGreen (sampler src, float param)                
{                                                               
    vec4 s;                                                     
    s = clamp(sample (src, samplerCoord (src)), 0.0, 1.0 );     
    s = rebalanceMoreGreen(s, param, .6);                       
    return s;                                                   
}                                                               

kernel vec4 moreMagenta (sampler src, float param)              
{                                                               
    vec4 s;                                                     
    s = clamp( sample (src, samplerCoord (src)), 0.0, 1.0);     
    s = rebalanceMoreMagenta(s, -param, .6);                    
    return s;                                                   
}

kernel vec4 correctWarmer (sampler src, float param)            
{                                                               
    vec4 s;                                                     
    s = clamp( sample (src, samplerCoord (src)) , 0.0, 1.0 );   
    s = rebalanceWarmer(s, param, .6);                          
    return s;                                                   
}                                                               

kernel vec4 correctCooler (sampler src, float param)            
{                                                               
    vec4 s;                                                     
    s = clamp( sample (src, samplerCoord (src)) , 0.0, 1.0 ) ;  
    s =rebalanceCooler(s, -param, .6);                          
    return s;                                                   
}

{                                                               
    vec4 s;
